comparison.objective: Calibrate a mounted tool tip by touching one reference point from four distinct orientations.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-point contact, pose diversity, and steady force/position holding.
comparison.success_condition: Four one-second tip contacts at allowed lean angles, each axis separated by at least 15°, with the tool mount unchanged.
comparison.reason: Multi-pose contact calibration does not require mating two support profiles, advancing an object across their seam, or preventing free balls from escaping.
